timing_boundary: seconds are mutant Lean command elapsed times; one-time pristine checks, cache fetching and orchestration overhead are excluded
verdict: no survivors in executed selected slices
score_label: sampled selected-dependent-slice mutation score, not area-wide assurance
boundary: Kernel elaboration of pinned source and selected dependent paths; first failure stops each mutant. Not external EVM/solc conformance, exhaustive dependency coverage, or a reference-class ratio.
limitations: no systemd scope on the cloud VM (H232)
No full rebuild from scratch; published cache and baseline selected builds required.
Kills measure existing proof recheck failures, including tactic dependence on definitional form; they do not alone prove a theorem statement semantically distinguishes the mutant.
M31 strengthens/restricts a recognizer; survival can be vacuity rather than missing proof.
